sentences.text: Rodney George `` Rod '' Laver -LRB- born 9 August 1938 -RRB- is an Australian former tennis player widely regarded as one of the greatest in tennis history .	tennis	tennis

He was the No. 1 ranked professional from 1964 to 1970 , spanning four years before and three years after the start of the Open Era .	Open Era	Open Era	1970	1970 Pepsi-Cola Masters – Singles	1964	Wembley Championship#1964	No. 1 ranked	World number one male tennis player rankings
He also was the No. 1 amateur in 1961 -- 62 according to Lance Tingay .	Lance Tingay	Lance Tingay	1961	1961 Davis Cup

Laver 's 200 singles titles are the most in tennis history , and he holds the all-time male singles records of 22 titles in a single season -LRB- 1962 -RRB- and seven consecutive years -LRB- 1964 -- 70 -RRB- winning at least 10 titles per season .	1962	1962 Davis Cup	1964	Wembley Championship#1964	tennis	tennis
He excelled on all of the court surfaces of his time : grass , clay , hard , carpet , and wood/parquet .
Despite being banned from playing the Grand Slam tournaments for the five years prior to the Open Era , he still won 11 singles titles .	Open Era	Open Era	Grand Slam	Grand Slam (tennis)

He is the only player to twice achieve the calendar-year Grand Slam , in 1962 -LRB- pre-open era -RRB- and 1969 -LRB- open era -RRB- , and remains the only man to do so during the Open Era .	Open Era	Open Era	1962	1962 Davis Cup	1969	1969 US Open – Men's Singles	Grand Slam	Grand Slam (tennis)

He also won eight Pro Slam titles , including the calendar year Pro `` Grand Slam '' in 1967 , and contributed to five Davis Cup titles for Australia during an age when Davis Cup was deemed as significant as the Grand Slams .	1967	French Pro Championship#1967	Grand Slam	Grand Slam (tennis)	Pro Slam	Major professional tennis tournaments before the Open Era	Davis Cup	Davis Cup
